admission.justification: Realized across src/rh_pipeline/cli/audit.py, pyproject.toml and the generated audit/*.json snapshots, with CLI tests proving exit codes 0, 1 and 2 and honest artifact emission.

applicability: Command-line invocation of rh-audit (src/rh_pipeline/cli/audit.py and pyproject.toml) and the generated audit/provenance.json and audit/verification-status.json snapshots.
conditions: Collection, scanning and status assembly complete before any write so AuditInputError and AuditScanError return exit code 2 without creating or modifying output files.
Exit code 1 still writes both audit JSON files so solution forbidden-token findings remain visible; exit code 0 requires zero solution forbidden tokens.
exclusions: Uncaught OS write failures after validation and argparse usage errors follow standard Python/argparse exit behavior.
statement: The rh-audit CLI entry point wires --upstream, --out, --scope, and --replay with exit codes 0 (clean), 1 (solution forbidden tokens found, still writing honest JSON), and 2 (input/scan error without writing), and emits deterministic audit/provenance.json and audit/verification-status.json.
title: Deterministic rh-audit CLI exit codes and emitted Phase 0 audit snapshots
